# 1 Record refresh pipeline

## Outcome
I want records refreshed end to end so that a reader can trust the output file.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-1 (behavioral): Given an input file, When the pipeline runs, Then it writes three output files.
- AC-2 (behavioral): Given the output and a golden set, When compare runs, Then it reports agreement.
- AC-3 (property): For all changed records, an evidence link is present.
- AC-4 (property): For all model calls, tokens are logged per stage.
- AC-5 (behavioral): Given a record already resolved, When verify runs again, Then it is not re-queried.
- AC-6 (critical): Given the golden set, When the first run completes, Then a baseline metric exists.
- AC-7 (behavioral): Given a changed record, When written, Then the evidence carries a date.
- AC-8 (property): For all stages, each reads and writes a file.
- AC-9 (behavioral): Given two verifiers disagree, When merge runs, Then the record is flagged.
- AC-10 (behavioral): Given the source constraint, When verify runs, Then the source type is logged.

## Slices
1. `1.1` — tracer bullet: stub outputs end to end
2. `1.2` — match stage
3. `1.3` — verify stage
4. `1.4` — merge stage
5. `1.5` — compare to golden set
6. `1.6` — deduplication and source logging
7. `1.7` — escalation pass

## Reopened decisions (post-approval)
1. `9.9` — not a slice; must not be counted
